definitions.gloss: being enrolled in school, attending school
definitions.explanation: The state of being registered as a student at an educational institution.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}に{在学|ざいがく}している。
{在学|ざいがく}{中|ちゅう}にアルバイトをした。
examples.english: I worked part-time while I was in school.

examples.japanese: {在学|ざいがく}{証明書|しょうめいしょ}を{発行|はっこう}してもらった。
examples.english: I had a certificate of enrollment issued.

notes:
COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{在学|ざいがく}{中|ちゅう} (while enrolled in school)
・{在学|ざいがく}{生|せい} (enrolled student, current student)
・{在学|ざいがく}{証明書|しょうめいしょ} (certificate of enrollment)
・{在学|ざいがく}{期間|きかん} (period of enrollment)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{通学|つうがく} - commuting to school
・{在籍|ざいせき} - being registered/enrolled (more general, also for organizations)

[Register: Formal]
